scope: Model-free deterministic verifier orchestration. No new real profile, old payload pass or prior-gate eligibility claim.

clock.start: First main action, before handler/source reads, import validation, inspection or hashing
clock.cooperative_limit: Blocking I/O may return late. Account late return/ownership first, stop new validation, attempt bounded cleanup, never claim complete after deadline; no OS preemption guarantee.

pipeline.purpose: Capture start first; pure CLI/path-shape check; exclusively reserve new verifier output and append journal before inspecting original evidence.
Fresh bounded technical anchors under original leases; strict exact role/schema/collision/build/decision checks; construct one owner-local immutable context.
One fresh hash pass per exact original payload plus all required software/owner/artifact leaves; retain bounded small bytes with digest and live leases.
Validate exact file universe, root/protocol bindings, receipt/seal output DAG, failure-marker precedence and every canonical journal link from captured bytes.
Decode retained raw Job/PID/limit/capture/exit/cleanup records and reconcile all required source-bound observations; no live OS/Job/process calls.
Run strict positive gate and separate negative/all-row observer on captured bytes under the same deadline; domain-negative observations do not bypass remaining required checks.
Reconcile hashes, stage results, coverage, unknown states, original file universe and all required gate outcomes; candidate status remains nonfinal.
Close every known original lease once; preserve primary/later/unknown outcomes; publish bounded verifier receipt/seal; final same-clock check before complete result.

roles.large_models: Only individually predeclared exact original path/size/hash records; never a general large-file exception

contains: strict original file descriptors and role map
nonserialized owner nonce and stage ledger
forbidden: using a copied payload as fresh original authority
weakening per-row/schema/cap/source checks because an index exists
context.publication: Captured-byte and admission indexes are owner-local implementation state, not future serialized authority

bounds.bounds_scope: Prospective verifier caps only. Exact approved role roster remains authoritative and can be narrower; no runtime/model budget change.

operation_states.return_order: Reserve before dispatch; register returned handles and valid known byte counts before clock/log/digest work; then check deadline. Hash-updated bytes remain separate from known-returned bytes.
operation_states.late_return: After expired work deadline, no further hashing/parsing/admission. Retain bookkeeping; cleanup only under unchanged absolute deadline.
operation_states.cleanup: One registry owns all handles. No destructor/context fallback retries an uncertain close; primary error remains immutable and later errors append.
operation_states.uncertainty: Attempt-minus-return and undefined failed-read counts are unknown, never zero/no-side-effect evidence.

result_semantics.complete_positive_evidence: All required verification and strict profile gates true, all closure/publication returned before deadline; not science/inference/full-mask qualification.
result_semantics.complete_consistent_negative: All required integrity/archive/resource/observer/closure/publication checks completed, while the observed source profile is definitively negative. Never a profile pass.
result_semantics.failed_inconsistent_evidence: Definitive role/hash/schema/archive/source contradiction; remaining stages explicitly not attempted as appropriate.
result_semantics.incomplete_timeout: Any required stage, cleanup/publication or final clock incomplete/late.
result_semantics.incomplete_publication: Missing/failed terminal evidence or failure-marker persistence prevents a complete result.

future_adapter.allowed_design_surface: Injected file identity/read/close plus verifier-output sink only; approved live adapter requires separate source review and root authorization.
forbidden: opening any old real original during current source/pure work

pure_test_plan.cases: Known complete positive/negative fake archives; assert reserve-before-inspect and all required stages/close/seal/final clock before complete.
Missing/additional/aliased/boolean-sized/wrong-hash/dynamic-cycle/foreign model/unknown image leaves reject before fake open; exact model exceptions only.
Returned late handle remains owned/closed once. Valid late bytes count before deadline but are not newly hashed after expiry; failed undefined counts and unreturned reads remain unknown.
Digest/capture/publication failure after known read preserves known bytes, separate hash progress and primary error.
Expire at each boundary, omit/reorder a required stage and exhaust work reserve; no reset, continuation validation or complete result.
Expected unavailable coverage stays negative; malformed core bytes are inconsistent/unknown. Negative gate does not skip archive/resources/closure.
Wrong journal link/tip, receipt hash/universe, missing seal/failure veto, raw PID/count/limit/EOF/exit mismatch, truncated evidence.
Close false/throws/late: exactly one attempt, preserved primary and unknown states, no complete result.
Early write/seal failure and after-seal deadline veto any candidate status; caller nonzero/incomplete remains authoritative.
Owner-local captured bytes/index remain immutable; serialized ready flags and cross-owner reuse reject; duplicate output cannot retry.
Retained byte/event/handle/row caps reject before unbounded allocation; stream fake model bytes without whole-model capture.
Fake clock/leases/in-memory sink only, no real paths, imports of old helpers, SDK/native or files. Assert stage/operation timestamps and unchanged original deadline.

remaining: Root must critically review this design before code/pure implementation. No real adapter or invocation follows from design approval.
